items.title: BG Q3 deep dive: network flexibility and project ramp-up shape outlook amid volatile environment
items.summary: Global agribusiness company Bunge Global (NYSE:BG) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with sales up 7.4% year on year to $23.8 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.56 per share was 5.6% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: How Investors Are Reacting To Bunge Global Stock Earnings Beat
items.summary: Bunge Global reported third quarter 2026 sales of US$23.8b and net income of US$318 million, with adjusted earnings of US$2.56 per share beating analyst expectations. Stronger soybean and softseed processing, early Viterra integration benefits, and ongoing portfolio pruning, including a deal to sell two Brazilian sugar mills, were key earnings drivers despite higher costs in some units.
